name: Japanese Addresses in Romaji
description: Japanese addresses written in the Latin alphabet: English order (the block first, the country last) and Japanese order, Hepburn with and without macrons, the designators -ku, -shi, -cho, -machi, -gun and chome, and the English words City, Ward and Prefecture. The prefecture and municipality are reported in kanji from the tables; the town and building stay as written. Original case written for this corpuss; shapes follow Japan Post's guidance on writing an address (郵便番号・住所の書き方), described in our own words; nothing copied for mail from abroad.
